scripts.build:ui: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }; cd ../project-notebook_frontend; npm install; npm run build; cd ../project-notebook_backend; Copy-Item -Recurse ../project-notebook_frontend/dist ."
